criteria.statement: the matcher resolves candidates from the index's oracle-membership and fetches detail via slice H's lazy loader; no path assumes an in-memory array of every variant
game complete/non-intent, game partial/explicit, lookup attached/explicit, and lookup no-card/no-intent branches all pass against a realistic-scale artifact
quantity-aware distinct-instance assignment holds at scale; one instance never fills two slots across a larger candidate pool
stable top-five ranking across the full six-key order holds when the pre-ranking candidate pool is large
state annotation resolves to the matched (or expected) zone correctly when detail is fetched lazily
both prompt paths render the combo section correctly end to end against the same realistic-scale artifact
rendered classification never emits the bare word complete; the state-verification instruction is present in both prompt modes
